import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split('\n')
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    while t > 0:
        n, m = map(int, input[index].split())
        index += 1
        friendships = {}
        for _ in range(m):
            a, b = map(int, input[index].split())
            if a not in friendships:
                friendships[a] = set()
            friendships[a].add(b)
            index += 1
        found = False
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            if i not in friendships:
                jury = [i]
                contestants = list(range(1, n + 1))
                contestants.remove(i)
                results.append("Yes")
                results.append(f"{len(jury)} {len(contestants)}")
                results.append(" ".join(map(str, jury)))
                results.append(" ".join(map(str, contestants)))
                found = True
                break
            else:
                potential_contestants = set(range(1, n + 1)) - friendships[i]
                if len(potential_contestants) >= 1:
                    jury = [i]
                    contestants = list(potential_contestants)
                    results.append("Yes")
                    results.append(f"{len(jury)} {len(contestants)}")
                    results.append(" ".join(map(str, jury)))
                    results.append(" ".join(map(str, contestants)))
                    found = True
                    break
        if not found:
            results.append("No")
        t -= 1
    print("\n".join(results))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
